hook: My dog can't fail in this game. I tried five ways.
log: Way one: walk straight into a log. Bonk! He says he meant to do that.
rain: Way two: go out in the rain. Wet dog smell intensifies. Then a dry, cosy nap indoors.
show: Way three: lose the dog show. Mrs. Plum still pins a ribbon on him.
away: Way four: forget about him for a week. Gerald sends a treat bag and a hundred coins. Welcome back!
trick: Way five: get every trick wrong. He invented a brand new trick. Nobody knows what it is.
payoff: Nothing bad ever happens here. That's the point.
ask: What should I try next? Comment a way to fail!
